title: factory.work-plan/v1 output artifact — ordered dispatchable-ticket plan with complete candidate accounting (WM-350)

recommendation.description: DISPATCH when at least one Todo + ai:agent-ready + unassigned ticket fits the per-repo in-flight cap with Owned Paths disjoint from all in-flight work; LOW_SUPPLY when there are zero ready candidates (after complete filtering, before cap/overlap pruning) and a non-empty complete Triage backlog; NOOP otherwise with a typed noopReason

repo.description: Echo of the short repo name from the input

ticket.description: The plan's first ticket; must equal plan[0].ticket for DISPATCH and be null otherwise

plan.description: Queue-ordered tickets using explicit Linear priority rank Urgent (1), High (2), Medium (3), Low (4), No priority (0), then createdAt ascending. Every item is dispatchable right now: state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee null; within the per-repo in-flight cap; Owned Paths mutually disjoint and disjoint from every in-flight ticket's paths. Every plan item chains to its own dispatch request

ticket.description: Linear issue identifier, dispatchable at scan time: state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee field null

ownedPaths.description: The ticket's Owned Paths globs as parsed at scan time — the disjointness evidence this plan rests on; a ticket with no parseable section owns everything (["**"]) and can only ever be planned alone

items.description: One Owned Paths glob, verified against the pinned tree at ./repo

reason.description: One line of why this ticket made the plan at this position, naming its priority by label (Urgent, High, Medium, Low, or No priority) rather than only by number, plus age and path disjointness

deferred.description: Every ready candidate not selected into plan, with the typed reason it cannot start during this scan. Together plan and deferred account for every ready candidate on DISPATCH

ticket.description: Linear issue identifier of the ready candidate that was not selected

reason.description: Typed reason this candidate cannot start: no remaining in-flight slot, or Owned Paths overlap with in-flight/selected work

readyCandidates.description: Count after a complete read is filtered to state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee null, before cap/overlap pruning; must equal evidence.candidatesSeen

triageBacklog.description: Count of remaining Triage issues from the independent complete read; 0 when Triage is not read because ready candidates exist

summary.description: One line an operator can act on

noopReason.description: Typed reason accompanying a NOOP — no Todo + ai:agent-ready + unassigned tickets exist, the per-repo in-flight cap is already full, or every dispatchable ticket's Owned Paths collide with in-flight work or with each other
